description: NaNdS₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NdS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NdS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are four shorter (2.85 Å) and two longer (3.12 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Nd is bonded to six S atoms to form NdS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NdS₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NdS₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are two shorter (2.83 Å) and four longer (2.85 Å) Nd-S bond lengths. There are five inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Nd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Nd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the second S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Nd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Nd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There is one shorter (2.83 Å) and two longer (2.85 Å) S-Nd bond lengths. In the third S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Nd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Nd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Nd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Nd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are two shorter (2.85 Å) and one longer (3.12 Å) S-Na bond length. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Nd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Nd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There is one shorter (2.83 Å) and two longer (2.85 Å) S-Nd bond lengths.
